gate.summary-write.say: only the summary writer writes a summary, so the session never writes the summary it reports. Start the summary-writer agent on the pack.

gate.summary-record.say: only the summary checker records a summary's verdict, so a summary is never passed by whoever wrote it. Start the summary-checker agent on the pack.

gate.verdict.say: only the question checker records a verdict, so a draft is never passed by the session that wrote it. Start the question-checker agent on the draft.

gate.checked-files.say: questions-checked.json and the checker-stamps folder hold the question checker's verdicts, and only evalation-questions verdict writes them. Start the question-checker agent on the draft.
